profile.headline: Software Engineer - Senior Associate at Fannie Mae
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 15+ years of professional experience, including 10+ years in software development and 5+ years in test automation/software quality engineering. Experienced in designing, developing, modernizing, testing, and supporting scalable enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, Python, AWS, microservices, and cloud-native technologies.

Profile
Senior Software Engineer specializing in Java, Spring Boot, Python, REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native development, with experience leading technical design and development of enterprise applications in the mortgage domain.·     

Experienced in modernizing enterprise applications using Java, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, and AWS SDK for Java, including platform, framework, and dependency upgrades to improve maintainability, security, performance, and alignment with current engineering standards.·      

Hands-on experience designing and implementing AWS cloud solutions using Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, ECS/Fargate, API Gateway, RDS/Aurora, and secure configuration services, including serverless file-processing and validation workflows.·     

Developed reusable engineering components and secure enterprise integrations, including shared Java/AWS DynamoDB libraries, REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, JWT, and role-based access control (RBAC).·      

Experienced in automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and production support using Playwright, Karate, Cucumber, JUnit 5, Jenkins, Splunk, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, and SonarQube.·       

Experienced in leveraging AI development tools throughout the software development lifecycle to support technical design, code generation, refactoring, debugging, test development, documentation, and rapid prototyping, improving developer productivity and delivery efficiency.,.
